what: GET /v1/calls/{id} for a call that connected, where the provider reported an acknowledgement and Ringdown did not
source: observed against the live REST API on 2026-08-20, the one call of five placed over REST that reached the recipient. Identifiers, phone numbers and spoken names are synthetic; the shape and every field that carries a finding are as observed.
unobserved: task was dropped: it is the text Ringdown sent. The audio behind transcript_turns was not captured, so how faithfully the provider transcribed it cannot be checked from here
why_it_matters: the whole argument of this app, observed rather than argued. The provider returned task_completed true at 0.86 high and its own evidence claims the engineer acknowledged taking the incident. The recipient turn it rests on reads 'Yes. I'm banking this incident right now' - speech recognition heard 'banking' for 'taking' - so no commitment phrase was ever spoken in the transcript, the disposition grounds to unclear and the verdict is not_acknowledged. A system branching on task_completed, the confidence label and the provider summary reports this incident as escalated. It also shows the ETA grounding working on the same call: 'K. Give me 15 minutes, please' is quoted as the span
